description: This file contains unit tests for the QuicheReferenceCounted class and related reference counting mechanisms, including tests for constructors, assignment, move semantics, and type conversions.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: A reference-counted base class that tracks destruction via a boolean pointer.

classes.name: Derived
classes.description: A subclass of Base used for testing type conversions.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCountedTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for reference counting tests.

methods.name: ConstructFromRawPointer
methods.description: Tests constructing a reference counted pointer from a raw pointer.

methods.name: RawPointerAssignment
methods.description: Tests assigning a raw pointer to a reference counted pointer.

methods.name: PointerCopyAssignment
methods.description: Tests copy assignment of reference counted pointers.

methods.name: PointerCopyFromOtherType
methods.description: Tests copying from a pointer of a derived type to a base type.

methods.name: PointerCopyAssignmentFromOtherType
methods.description: Tests copy assignment from a derived type pointer to a base type pointer.

methods.name: PointerMove
methods.description: Tests move semantics for reference counted pointers.

methods.name: PointerMoveAssignment
methods.description: Tests move assignment for reference counted pointers.

methods.name: PointerMoveFromOtherType
methods.description: Tests move semantics from a derived type to a base type.

methods.name: PointerMoveAssignmentFromOtherType
methods.description: Tests move assignment from a derived type to a base type.
